Enabling capture_svg processes inline SVG elements when extract_images is on

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<p>Below SVG:</p><svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"10\" height=\"10\"><rect width=\"10\" height=\"10\" fill=\"red\"/></svg>", "{\"capture_svg\":true,\"extract_images\":true}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
